fixtures.name: cf
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT k::INTEGER AS id, (k % 10)::INTEGER AS g, (k * 7919 % 1000)::BIGINT AS k2,
  CASE WHEN k % 13 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (k * 37 % 1000) / 8.0 END AS v,
  ((k * 31 % 100000) / 100.0)::DECIMAL(12,2) AS d,
  CASE WHEN k % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 's' || (k % 23) END AS s,
  DATE '2024-01-01' + (k % 400)::INTEGER AS dt
FROM range(1, 3001) t(k)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 700)

fixtures.name: cd
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT k::INTEGER AS pk, 'name' || k AS name, (k * 3)::INTEGER AS w FROM range(0, 8) t(k)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET)

fixtures.name: ce
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT k::INTEGER AS id, (k % 10)::INTEGER AS g, k::BIGINT AS k2, k / 8.0 AS v, k::DECIMAL(12,2) AS d,
  'x' AS s, DATE '2024-01-01' AS dt FROM range(0, 10) t(k) WHERE false) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET)

fixtures.name: li
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT o::BIGINT AS l_orderkey, (o * 13 + n) % 200 + 1 AS l_partkey, (o * 7 + n) % 20 + 1 AS l_suppkey,
  ((o * 31 + n * 17) % 50 + 1)::DECIMAL(15,2) AS l_quantity, ((o * 977 + n * 131) % 90000 / 1.0 + 900)::DECIMAL(15,2) AS l_extendedprice,
  ((o + n) % 11 / 100.0)::DECIMAL(15,2) AS l_discount, ((o * 3 + n) % 9 / 100.0)::DECIMAL(15,2) AS l_tax,
  CASE (o + n) % 3 WHEN 0 THEN 'A' WHEN 1 THEN 'N' ELSE 'R' END AS l_returnflag, CASE WHEN o % 2 = 0 THEN 'F' ELSE 'O' END AS l_linestatus,
  DATE '1994-01-01' + ((o * 37 + n * 5) % 1500)::INTEGER AS l_shipdate, CASE n % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 'MAIL' WHEN 1 THEN 'SHIP' WHEN 2 THEN 'AIR' ELSE 'RAIL' END AS l_shipmode
FROM range(1, 2001) a(o), range(0, 7) b(n) WHERE n < (o % 7) + 1) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 2000)

fixtures.name: ord
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT o::BIGINT AS o_orderkey, (o * 17 % 120 + 1)::BIGINT AS o_custkey, DATE '1993-06-01' + (o * 11 % 1600)::INTEGER AS o_orderdate,
  CASE o % 5 WHEN 0 THEN '1-URGENT' WHEN 1 THEN '2-HIGH' WHEN 2 THEN '3-MEDIUM' WHEN 3 THEN '4-NOT SPECIFIED' ELSE '5-LOW' END AS o_orderpriority,
  (o % 2)::INTEGER AS o_shippriority, CASE WHEN o % 9 = 0 THEN 'some special requests here' ELSE 'plain comment ' || o END AS o_comment
FROM range(1, 2001) t(o)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET)

fixtures.name: cus
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT c::BIGINT AS c_custkey, 'Customer#' || lpad(c::VARCHAR, 4, '0') AS c_name, (c % 10)::INTEGER AS c_nationkey,
  CASE c % 3 WHEN 0 THEN 'BUILDING' WHEN 1 THEN 'MACHINERY' ELSE 'AUTOMOBILE' END AS c_mktsegment FROM range(1, 151) t(c)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET)

fixtures.name: nat
